title: Ash-Buried Caravan
description: The skeletal remains of a trade caravan emerge from a dune of gray ash, wagon wheels jutting at broken angles and canvas long since burned away. Crates and barrels lie split open, their contents scattered by eruption and scavengers alike. The traders never made it out of the Ashen Horizons.

choices.label: Search the wagons
choices.description: Dig through the buried wagons for coin purses and strongboxes.

outcomes.text: You pry open a scorched strongbox wedged beneath the driver's seat. Coins spill out, still warm from the ash.
A few scattered coin purses turn up, but most have already been looted. You salvage what you can.
As you reach into the wreckage, a pocket of superheated air bursts from the ash. Embers sear exposed skin.

choices.label: Salvage the cargo
choices.description: Recover intact volcanic glass from the shattered trade goods.

outcomes.text: Wrapped in fireproof cloth, several pieces of volcanic glass survived the eruption intact. A fine haul.
Most of the cargo is ruined, but you find a few salvageable pieces of glass and some ember dust packed in clay jars.
The crates crumble as you touch them, sending a cascade of hot ash over your hands. Little of value remains.

choices.label: Leave the dead in peace
choices.description: There is nothing worth disturbing here.

outcomes.text: You bow your head briefly and move on. The ash settles back over the caravan like a funeral shroud.
